dct_description_sm: Contained within the 2nd Edition (1915) of the Atlas of Canada is a plate that consists of 2 maps illustrating international and interprovincial boundary historical claims. One map displays Ontario, Manitoba and adjacent parts of the US. The other map shows the Alaska boundary dispute. British Columbia and Yukon - Alaska boundary map presents the respective disputes of Great Britain and the United States. The Ontario-Manitoba boundary map was concentrated on the contestation of the Dominion and Manitoba disputing the Ontario boundary, but arrived on an agreement in 1912, and the boundary remained the same as it is displayed in the present. Major railway systems are presented on each map within the plate.
dct_title_s: International and Interprovincial Boundaries British Columbia and Yukon-Alaska Boundary, Ontario-Manitoba Boundaries
